subject: Fetch the pinned libexpat1 from snapshot.debian.org
description: CI for PR #136 fails because the ladder-crop-distill image ADDs libexpat1_2.8.3-1~deb13u1_amd64.deb from the Debian security pool, which no longer serves that version (HTTP 404). snapshot.debian.org serves the identical file (sha256 38abe0e7..., the existing pin). Scope: the ADD URL in docker/ladder-crop-distill/Dockerfile only; the sha256 check is unchanged. Review: Codex.
